sections.st: Cardiology Packaging Manufacturer India — Cardiac Catheter & Implant Packaging, Cleanroom Class 8 · Vapi
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures cardiology packaging from our Cleanroom Class 8, GMP-compliant, ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom PETG thermoformed packaging for the complete cardiology and cardiac surgery device range. Cardiology packaging manufacturer from Vapi for cardiac catheterization device companies, electrophysiology device manufacturers, cardiac implant companies, and cardiac surgery instrument manufacturers across India and for export.

Cardiology medical device packaging covers both interventional cardiology devices (catheters, stents, balloons used in catheterization laboratory procedures) and cardiac implants (pacemakers, ICDs, cardiac valves) — the highest value and most life-critical category in medical device packaging. Cardiac implant packaging must protect devices worth tens of thousands of dollars through the supply chain. Cardiac catheter packaging must protect delicate balloon and stent systems from any mechanical damage that would cause device failure during a cardiac intervention procedure.

strips.title: Coronary Stent Balloon — Any Packaging Contact Can Rupture the Balloon
strips.desc: Problem: Coronary stent delivery system packaging where any surface contacts the balloon causes micro-perforation — a balloon ruptured during the coronary intervention is a cardiac emergency. Solution: Balloon clearance analysis from stent delivery system drawing — balloon outer diameter with clearance zone. No packaging contact at any point along the balloon length.

strips.title: Pacemaker Lead Coil — Conductor Wire Must Not Be Stressed at Packaging Coil Points
strips.desc: Problem: Pacemaker lead packaging where the coil radius is below the conductor wire minimum bend radius causes conductor fatigue at the coil points — conductor fracture may occur after implantation under cardiac motion stress. Solution: Conductor minimum bend radius confirmed from lead technical specification. Coil cavity radius confirmed to exceed the minimum bend radius at all points.

strips.title: Cardiac Valve Storage — Valve Must Be Maintained in Sterile Preservative Solution
strips.desc: Problem: Cardiac valve packaging where the PETG tray cannot maintain the valve in sterile glutaraldehyde or saline preservative solution causes valve tissue desiccation and failure. Solution: Cardiac valve tray depth confirmed to maintain the valve submerged in preservative solution at the specified volume. Cavity geometry from valve technical drawing.

strips.title: Coronary Stent Balloon Clearance — No Packaging Contact on Balloon Profile
strips.desc: Balloon outer diameter confirmed from stent delivery system technical drawing. Cavity provides defined clearance zone over the balloon length — no packaging contact on balloon surface at any handling orientation.

strips.title: Pacemaker Lead Minimum Bend Radius — Conductor Fatigue Prevention
strips.desc: Conductor minimum bend radius confirmed from lead technical specification. Coil cavity radius confirmed to exceed minimum bend radius at all points on the coil path.

strips.title: Cardiac Valve Preservative Solution Containment
strips.desc: Cardiac valve tray depth and seal geometry designed to maintain valve submerged in preservative solution at specified volume. Tray depth confirmed from valve dimensions and solution volume specification.
